'''Mora''' will be a [[Wise One]] in the future seen by [[Aviendha]] among the [[Glass columns]] in [[Rhuidean]].

==Appearance and Abilities==
She is described as having a "matronly voice" and is presumably at least middle-aged. She cannot channel.

==Activities==
She and [[Ladalin]] are the only other Wise Ones that meets with [[Tamaav]], [[Takai]] and [[Jorshem]] to discuss the losing war against the [[Seanchan]]. 

It is Mora who suggests the Aiel withdraw into the [[Aiel Waste|Three-fold Land]].
